annotations.title: Confirm that an Arroway read is complete

description: After the final part of a multi-part Arroway read arrives, acknowledge it with its read_id and receipt. This closes the sequence and records that the whole snapshot was received. It is not a precondition for working: delivery is already recorded when the first part arrives.

read_id.description: Opaque id returned by the incomplete arroway_read response.

receipt.description: Opaque receipt returned by the final part.

name: arroway_complete_read
title: Confirm that an Arroway read is complete
